name: write-paper
description: Modular, re-entrant theoretical physics LaTeX paper workflow (v4: the author decides the story, AI writes and checks): starts from any stage on a paper at any completion; a briefing (results, verified literature map, open questions) for the author's story discussion; one author drafting only missing blocks; a report-only check; concerns that touch the story go back to the author; deterministic clean-up and build; effort levels; optional blind referee panel.

mode.description: auto runs what the paper still needs from wherever it stands (stops for the author at the briefing, the story confirmation and blocking concerns); survey reports where it stands; or a single stage. Aliases: full_auto=auto, draft_and_check=auto from draft, check_and_revise=auto from check, blueprint=story, verify/citations=check, hygiene=cleanup, repair=revise.

paper_dir.description: Target LaTeX paper project root directory.

effort.description: How much checking and literature work a run does: low (lineage only, no scripted numeric checks, reader check merged into the main-text check, 6 in parallel), medium, high (wider literature map, 10 numeric checks, low-severity fixes, a blind referee at the end). Explicit max_parallel / max_numeric_checks / revise_low win.

start.description: auto: start at this stage and run to the end (brief reopens the story; check skips writing).

only_files.description: Limit draft, check and revise to these files (relative to paper_dir).

reference_pdfs.description: Folder of PDFs named <bibkey>.pdf; the citation check reads these in full when an abstract is not enough (otherwise it fetches the arXiv full text).

citation_notes_dir.description: Where citation verdicts and per-work reading notes are kept (default <paper_dir>/.workflow/citation_notes); share one folder across papers to reuse them.

source_paths.description: Directories or files containing core derivation notes, reports, verification scripts, and figures.

authority_paths.description: Highest-authority scope, red-line and numeric protocol documents; the checkers compare the manuscript against them and the ledger.

exemplar_paths.description: Well-written published papers (.tex or .pdf); curated paragraphs from them are the author's voice samples.

existing_bib.description: Optional path to an existing .bib file to seed citation verification.

genre.description: Target venue format: 'letter' (PRL + SuppMat) or 'long' (PRB/PRX/CMP + Appendices).

figure_style.description: Journal visual style preset for figures phase and verify_figures.py.

pause_after_story.description: auto: stop for the author at the briefing (story discussion), at the story confirmation and at blocking concerns. false = unattended: the agent chooses the story and concerns wait in 07_feedback.json.

max_numeric_checks.description: check: how many core results (main-text ones first) get an independent scripted check (default from effort: low 0, medium 4, high 10).

revise_low.description: revise: also hand the author files whose issues are all low severity (default: only at effort high).

check_backend.description: Run the check stage on another vendor's CLI (e.g. Gemini writes, Claude checks). Works in both runtimes.

referee_backend.description: Run blind_referee on another vendor's CLI.

blueprint_path.description: v2 workspaces only: 01_blueprint.json, read for its figure list.

supplement_tex.description: Optional path to Supplemental Material .tex (defaults to <paper_dir>/supplement.tex if present).

figure_specs_path.description: Optional JSON file describing target figures, CSV/data inputs, and captions.

skill_dir.description: Optional explicit path to the write-paper skill directory.

repair_instructions.description: mode='revise' (alias 'repair'): a referee/audit report path or the instructions as text. Without it, revise works from the latest check report (.workflow/03_issues.json).

repair_files.description: Optional subset of files for mode='revise' with instructions (relative to paper_dir or absolute).

routing_policy.description: auto_tiered: each call is routed by its task tier (heavy / builder / fast / probe) to a model per runtime; uniform_inherit: every call uses the host/CLI default. An explicit models[stage] always wins.

plan_mode.description: Antigravity only: whether run_workflow was called from a Planning Turn. 'auto' reads it from trajectory(); 'off' (Execution Turn) sends inherit-tier calls to the standalone agy CLI (or model='pro' without it), because an inherit sub-agent deadlocks on '[plan review due]' there.

repair_skip_plan.description: mode='revise' with instructions: skip the LLM router and give every file in repair_files the full instructions (automatic when repair_files has exactly one file).

sync_bib.description: Optional updated .bib file to sync into refs.bib during repair or citations.

max_parallel.description: Maximum concurrent agent calls per batch (default from effort: low 6, medium 4, high 4).

agent_timeout_s.description: Wall-clock limit for one agent call: Antigravity agent(...) handles are abandoned with an error, CLI backends have their whole process tree killed. Timed-out calls are never retried (they may already have edited files).

agent_retries.description: Retries for a failed or timed-out agent call (rate limits, overload, transient CLI errors).

max_scan_agents.description: Upper bound on Stage-0 scan agents; small source files are packed together, and the run stops with a message instead of fanning out further.

skip_lm.description: Ignored since v3 (style_metrics never scores perplexity); kept so older Args stay valid.

models.description: Explicit per-stage models (override routing_policy); v2 stage names (narrative, cross_verify, citation_check, repair) still map to story, check, check, revise. Antigravity: native tiers ('inherit', 'pro', 'flash', 'flash_lite') or an agy model id; CLI backends: a model name for that CLI.
